narrative.northStar: ศูนย์ประสานงาน (Coordination Centre)
narrative.overview:
A calm Thai-first workspace connects a numbered streetlight, readable repair status, and the next action. The eight user-supplied mobile mockups received 10 November 2026 are the visual authority for reporting, My Work, available work, pending management, pole registry, pole detail, repair history and accounts. Desktop expands their hierarchy into useful columns.

Deep teal headings and header anchor a warm pale working ground. White rounded records, generous fields, orange waiting states, mint completed states and blue active states support quick scanning. Yellow remains the brand and primary-action cue. The approved lowercase Nunito wordmark sits beside a gold bolt bulb. IBM Plex Sans Thai, reduced-motion behavior, functions and data remain binding preservation constraints.
keyCharacteristics: Pole identity and status precede secondary detail.
The phone viewport begins the task directly.
Segmented switches use a deep teal selected segment.
Desktop adds room for side-by-side records and a docked pole reader.

rules.name: The Status Words Rule
rules.body: Pair status color with readable words or an explicit count label; do not rely on color alone.

rules.name: The Identifier First Rule
rules.body: Make the pole number and status easy to find before secondary detail.

dos: Do use the eight supplied mobile mockups as visual authority and adapt their hierarchy to desktop.
Do preserve the original font files, separate bulb/wordmark, animations and reduced-motion behavior.
Do retain every existing function and data path while styling records, tabs and forms.
Do keep status words and labels visible alongside color.
donts: Don't replace the original typefaces or redraw the logo as combined artwork.
Don't restore the superseded square yellow form badges, yellow pending counts or pale-yellow selected work segments.
Don't make mobile records depend on an unlabeled wide table or use the supplied mockups as fixed desktop-width canvases.
